Order of Austin County, Texas, Regarding Battery Energy Storage Systems and Data Centers Health and Safety Review, adopted by the Commissioners Court on 2026-07-27 under Texas Health and Safety Code section 121.003 and Texas Local Government Code section 352.016, among other authorities. The signed, executed order was located directly on austincounty.com (distinct from the earlier unsigned draft). It suspends county permit, plan-review, and inspection approvals for BESS and data center construction in unincorporated areas until a 'Comprehensive Health and Safety Review' (covering fire/life-safety, cybersecurity/foreign-adversary equipment verification tied to the Lone Star Infrastructure Protection Act and the Governor's Prohibited Technologies List, and an Energy Development Zone siting study) is complete, with the Commissioners Court retaining sole discretion over when that review is finished. It requires County Fire Marshal plan review/approval and an independent third-party engineering evaluation before construction, and authorizes the County's legal counsel to seek injunctive relief against violators.
